name: Delete monitored domain
description: Delete monitored domain Remove a domain from credential monitoring. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/credential-monitor/domains/{id}

name: List monitored domains
description: List monitored domains List all domains registered for credential monitoring. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/credential-monitor/domains
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/credential-monitor/domains
List all domains registered for credential monitoring.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID
Optional: page (query) — Page number; per_page (query) — Items per page

name: List credential matches
description: List credential matches Get credential matches for the account's monitored domains. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/credential-monitor/matches
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/credential-monitor/matches
Get credential matches for the account's monitored domains.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID
Optional: domain (query) — Filter by domain (exact match); username (query) — Filter by username (partial match); page (query) — Page number; per_page (query) — Items per page

name: Create monitored domain
description: Create monitored domain Register a domain for credential monitoring. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/credential-monitor/domains
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/credential-monitor/domains
Register a domain for credential monitoring.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID
Optional: body (body)
